Lena (marketing): Heads-up 10: we need a compact battlecard for next week's webinar focused on two personas: FinOps (cost predictability) and Platform (SLOs/ops). 3 bullets each + 1-line rebuttal.
Marco (growth): For FinOps lead with a $/1k token example. That converts. Suggest A/B CTA test: 'Estimate your token bill' vs 'See live latency profile'.
Tess (product): Bench highlights: cached chat: $0.22/1k tokens, uncached ~ $0.60. Variant fallback improved success rate ~3x during congestion (link to bench: https://redwood.internal/benches/1805). bench-bot will post full CSV.
bench-bot: Bench CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/benches/1805 (internal)
Umar (sales): Rebuttal snips: "Why not cloud serverless?" -> "Serverless can spike costs and latency variance under load; Dedicated gives committed throughput and predictable invoices." Keep it short for email openers.
Val (content): I'll draft 3 slide hooks + 4 email subject lines (two per persona). Examples: 'Pin your token spend' and 'Stop tail latency from breaking your UX'. Need final bullets by 2pm.
Lena (marketing): Draft bullets below please critique:```
FinOps / Cost predictability:
- $0.22 / 1k tokens with caching vs ~$0.60 uncached (bench)
- Committed Dedicated pricing + Optimize recommendations reduce surprise spend
- Rebuttal: "What about hidden fees?" -> "Transparent token-level billing in Console."

Platform / Ops resilience:
- SLA-backed Dedicated reduces 99p latency jitter by ~3x during congestion (bench)
- Smart routing + model-variant fallback keeps success rate high under regional pressure
- Rebuttal: "Vendor lock-in?" -> "Portable model catalog + rollout controls let you move or run variants wherever you need."
```
Tess (product): Swap FinOps bullets to lead with the dollar figure (people ask price first). Also add one-sentence config note for SDRs: "Enable prefix caching + continuous batching to achieve bench numbers."
Marco (growth): I'll wire up the CTA AB test and track events: bench-click, demo-request, webinar-attend, q&a-engage.
Umar (sales): I'll post two 1-line outreach opens after lunch that lean cost-first and ops-first.
Lena (marketing): Action items: Tess paste CSV (by noon); Val deliver slide hooks + subjects (by 2pm); Marco run AB test; Umar draft outreach. I'll stitch the battlecard doc and publish in #docs when ready. :rocket:
